integrity_note: Finite and numerical checks supplement the displayed analytic argument. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite symmetric Dirichlet parameters only; heterogeneous vectors and random category counts are not covered.
Power order strictly greater than one; no assertion about the monotonicity of the root in power order.
Equivalent historical formulas in the larger literature remain a priority risk; standard Dirichlet moments themselves are not claimed as new.
title: A unique abundance-threshold covariance reversal for every Dirichlet power concentration
